name: 34103 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34103 (Naples) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34103 (Naples) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
